snippet.title: Bacon in Zane – Trailer
snippet.description:
Who would have thought – In the human body, every tiny action is being controlled by a simple tap. In this game, accompany a piece of bacon through the digestive process and control the bacteria in the small intestine, the breathing of the lungs, or the neurons in the brain: all with just one finger.

www.kamibox.de/baconinzane
